queer_characters.name: Xiaoqun
queer_characters.notes: Protagonist explicitly described as a lesbian elephant keeper navigating a relationship with a woman while resisting her mother's marriage pressure; central and fully realized character.

queer_characters.name: Xiaoling
queer_characters.notes: Described as Xiaoqun's girlfriend and a fabric saleswoman/market vendor; her same-sex relationship is central to the plot.

queer_characters.name: Junjun
queer_characters.notes: Identified as Xiaoqun's ex-girlfriend; her return as a fugitive introduces complications, tying queerness to a crime subplot per the source.

contributor_notes: Source notes this is reportedly the first mainland Chinese film to address lesbian relationships, distinguishing it from earlier gay-themed works like East Palace, West Palace (1996). Director Li Yu's own identity is not stated in the source, so no queer_creators entry was added. Marriage pressure from Xiaoqun's mother appears in the plot but the source does not explicitly frame it as homophobia, so no trigger warning was asserted; a maintainer may wish to review. Subtitles not discussed; audio language inferred as Chinese from the film's description as a Chinese-language production.
